description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/SearchProduct/SaveMultipleProductChanges. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Provides the POST save multiple product changes operation in existing published product/listing management. Use when: Use it when a client needs to run the save multiple product changes operation for existing published product/listing management. Input: [FromBody] changes: SaveMultipleProductChangesRequest. Main fields: ListingIds: int[], DataByListing: Dictionary<int, SaveMultipleProductChangesRequestD>, Markup: SaveProductChangeNumber, IncreaseMarkup: SaveProductChangeNumber, Price: SaveProductChangeDecimal, Quantity: SaveProductChangeNumber, Profit: SaveProductChangeNumber, MonitorPrice: SaveProductChangeBoolean, MonitorStock: SaveProductChangeBoolean, MonitorPriceDecrease: SaveProductChangeBoolean, PriceDecreasePercentage: SaveProductChangeNumber, IgnoreRules: SaveProductChangeBoolean, MinQuantity: SaveProductChangeNumber, PrimeOnly: SaveProductChangeBoolean, ShippingPolicy: SaveProductChangeLong, ReturnPolicy: SaveProductChangeLong, PaymentPolicy: SaveProductChangeLong, DispatchTimeDays: SaveProductChangeNumber. Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId. VAT is optional and only supported for eBay API: omit to leave unchanged, use {value: integer} from 0 to 100 to set, or {value: null} to remove the override and send zero to eBay. VAT applies to every variation of the affected eBay listing. Output: Returns the result or applies the effect of the save multiple product changes operation. Side effect: when a new channel stock quantity is applied to a listing variation, its previous channel stock quantity is recorded in the stock history (author: user), so it appears in the stock changes history. VAT settings are saved only for provider-accepted changes. Search terms: searchproduct savemultipleproductchanges. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires confirmed=true before execution. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact action.
